results.title: Last hunting ground
results.brief_description: A fishing trip by the “Southern Bluefin”, one of the Safcol fishing fleet hunting for the Southern Blue Fin tuna along the South Australian coast. Shows the crew in action spotting and catching fish for two days and then returning home with a load of Blue Fin tuna. Suitable for middle and upper primary and lower secondary levels.

results.brief_description: Surveys the activities of the Council of Adult Education in organising cultural activities throughout Victoria, showing particularly the annual Summer School conducted at Albury. The school extends over ten days and provides opportunities for the study of art and crafts, music, opera and drama.

results.title: The Web (Wolf, Scandinavia)
results.creator_credit: Lucinda Clutterbuck, Ray Argall, Fiona Eagger, ABC-TV (Australia), Australian Children's Television Foundation, Australian Film Commission, Eco Productions, Film Victoria and New South Wales Film and Television Office
results.brief_description:
Australian animated short examining the threatened survival of wolves in Scandinavia.

Part of Series 2 of The Web, an Australian animated series produced by Eco Productions examining endangered animals and environmental conservation. Each episode focuses on a different animal or habitat. No definitive episode running order has been established.
